# Rank 12 record curves

The ten smallest curves of rank 12 in this collection, in each of four
categories. The same curve often heads more than one list. Every curve here
has proven rank 12, is given by its global minimal model, and carries 12
independent generators, listed below each table.

All heights are natural logarithms. The naive height is
`log max(abs(c4)^3, c6^2)`; the Faltings height is
`-(1/2) log abs(Im(conj(w1) w2))` on the minimal model, the normalization used
by the [Elliptic Curve Rank Leaderboard](https://elliptic-rank.icarm.cloud).

Other ranks: [rank 4](rank_4.md) · [rank 5](rank_5.md) · [rank 6](rank_6.md) · [rank 7](rank_7.md) · [rank 8](rank_8.md) · [rank 9](rank_9.md) · [rank 10](rank_10.md) · [rank 11](rank_11.md) · [rank 12](rank_12.md) · [rank 13](rank_13.md) · [rank 14](rank_14.md)  |  back to the [main table](../README.md).
